g.text: car data, current reference set, open damage
signed links for the reference photos (≤ 5 min)
select or create the renter (+ additional driver)
save the client and the draft
dates, rates, deductible, card (brand, last 4, expiry),
draft saved as it is typed
check the draft is complete, the car still available
signature bottom right of every page
record the PDF (SHA-256, template and terms versions)
If the network drops, the app retries the upload and the call
with the same idempotency key: never two contracts.
